what: Running gap between the door's kick strip and the threshold
status_source: assumption: at least 3 mm so the door clears the threshold with hinge sag; at most 10 mm, the drop seal's travel until its datasheet is in (HOLD)
fix: Set the kick strip and threshold heights so the worst case stays inside the drop seal's range

joint: IF-03 and IF-04 back wall across its width
what: Gasket room left across the back wall: the space between the side frames less two back panels and three seams
status_source: assumption: the compressed gaskets need at least their own thickness; the joints register sets it
fix: Panel width = (space - 3 x compressed gasket) / 2, with the panel cut tolerance inside the gasket's range

joint: IF-01 IF-03 IF-04 IF-05 M6 bolt into a rivnut through a clearance hole
what: Radial clearance left for an M6 bolt after both hole positions and the locating feature's play (fixed-fastener case)
status_source: calculation: the bolt must enter without forcing (guideline section 6.3, worst case)
fix: Use a bigger clearance hole or a slot, or hold the hole positions and the locator tighter
